book.name: 2 MAKOLINTE
book.title: Elin̄olo lya Paulusi no wiili ku MAKOLINTE

content: Aka ni kawaatu aka niiya kwaanyi. “Ekatulo yonje kame ifanena okupakiwa kwaanu ayiili simba aatu.”

Kame nina kuba emamela kwaanu awo ana kutenda esibi oweli nanjili onje, mi nisaaba emamela nibano naba niulwileko kanyi omo nina kutendela aba nina kupota aka no wiili nji cwale aba saniiye kame sitamba okwafela amakeke.
Kakuli kame musaela eniti nji Kilesite kame aamba mwa mene, kafokola muku tenda mwaanyi kakuli kame akwite amaata mwaanyi.
Kakuli kame ana kungongotelwa mu ku fokola, kono kame ayoya ni maata a Nyambe. Kakuli kame tufokola mwa yonyene, kono mukutenda naanyi kame tuyoya naye mu maata a Nyambe.
Mu kutatube mwenyene oku mona nji musongotite mu tumelo yenu. Mu kweteke mwenyene, kamu lemuha nji Jesu Kilesite kame ali mwaanyi? Konji mwendi luli aba samu kwangwe oukweteka.
Kame nisepa nji kame samuwane nji katusi kwangwa.
Kono kame tulapela Nyambe nji mulese oku tenda ouyi kasanji tu monahale nji natutwese etatubo kono mutende eso silukile naba tumonahala nji natu kwangwa.
Kakuli katu twese okutenda esinjili okulwisa eniti, kono konji ba niti fela.
Kakuli kame tu wabelelwa aba tu fokola mi anyi kame mongolile. Cwale eso tu lapela ninji mu tende ano kupetahala.
Kame ni n̄ola etitaba eti abo me sisako kwanyi, nji cwale aba saniiye nilese oukutusisa onene etukelo eyo ananibi Mbumu eyo no kumiyaka mi kasa eyo no kumishandola.
Abaange amamaneneno kame ni milaana, mulukise etindila tenu, muyupe eyi naamba, mukuyupe mukaci kenu, muyoye mu kozo mi Nyambe no lilato ni kozo mbaikala naanyi.
Muku keete omunjili ku munjili mu ukutubeta no kukena.
Aanu a Nyambe onje no kukena kame amikeeta.
Esishemo sa Mbumu Jesu Kilesite ni lilato lya Nyambe, nuumweya no Mebo No Kukena iikale naanyi moonje.
